params.1273: Make a pot on a potter's wheel.
params.1274: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge.
params.1275: Pass the general store, Fred's sheep and chicken farm and the wheat fields until you reach a crossroads.
params.1276: The potter's house is just west of the crossroads.
params.1277: Click on the potter's wheel and choose to make a pot.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
